slides.title: Strong accents, dialects and fast speech
slides.subtitle: Extreme listening
goals: Follow very fast and accented speech.

slides.title: Strategies
list: Focus on stressed words; let the rest go.
Recognize common reductions: *gonna, wanna, dunno, innit, y'all*.
Expose yourself to varied sources: podcasts, regional TV, interviews.
